statement: For every fixed finite-depth LRNN M over exact rational arithmetic whose fixed-width parameter maps have arithmetic closed forms independent of sequence position, the language accepted by the sign of M's final rational readout has an FO-uniform polynomial-size bounded-fan-in arithmetic circuit family of O(log n) depth; equivalently, it is in PNC^1.

universal: fixed LRNN M satisfying the stated assumptions
existential: an FO-uniform PNC^1 circuit family C_M,n
quantifiers.obligation: C_M,n(w) accepts exactly when M accepts w

assumptions: The alphabet, number of layers, head count, and all hidden dimensions are constants fixed by M.
Arithmetic is exact over Q and rational values have polynomial-size representations.
A_t(x_t), b_t(x_t), queries, feed-forward maps, normalization, and readout are arithmetic closed forms independent of t.
The paper's cited closed-form-to-FO-uniform-TC^0 lemma and standard finite-composition closure are used as trusted library lemmas.
pass_condition: All certificate lemmas are present; the formal affine composition normalizes identically under both parenthesizations; the balanced circuit recurrence has depth ceil(log2 n) and n-1 product nodes at power-of-two boundaries and adjacent cases; the independent numeric implementation agrees; and the deliberately reversed-bias composition is rejected as non-associative.
fail_condition: Any missing assumption, source-hash mismatch, algebraic mismatch, resource-bound mismatch, independent-checker mismatch, or negative-control pass exits nonzero.
limitations: The checker reconstructs the LRNN-to-affine-circuit compiler and its universal algebraic/resource invariants. It treats the cited closed-form-to-FO-uniform-TC^0 result and standard circuit-class closure facts as trusted library lemmas rather than re-proving those foundations.
